goal: Extract the cohesive DOTALL-oriented regex responsibility (pattern compilation with DOTALL and DOTALL-based replace/remove helpers) from RegExUtils into a new helper class to reduce the number of public methods on RegExUtils and reduce its LOC.

expected_impact.rationale: The extracted class will contain the DOTALL-focused public API: dotAll, dotAllMatcher (both overloads), replacePattern (CharSequence and deprecated String overload), removePattern (CharSequence and deprecated String overload) plus the private helper toStringOrNull. Moving these 7 public methods (and the supporting private helper) reduces RegExUtils' public method count and overall LOC by extracting a cohesive responsibility (DOTALL-specific pattern/matcher helpers). The moved methods are self-contained and reference only each other or simple helpers that are moved as well, so behavior is preserved.

ops.details:
Extract a new class org.apache.commons.lang3.RegExDotAllUtils containing the DOTALL-related methods and their supporting helper from RegExUtils. Moved members (signatures):
- public static Pattern dotAll(String regex)
- public static Matcher dotAllMatcher(String regex, CharSequence text)
- @Deprecated public static Matcher dotAllMatcher(String regex, String text)
- public static String replacePattern(CharSequence text, String regex, String replacement)
- @Deprecated public static String replacePattern(String text, String regex, String replacement)
- public static String removePattern(CharSequence text, String regex)
- @Deprecated public static String removePattern(String text, String regex)
- private static String toStringOrNull(CharSequence text)

The extraction removes these methods from RegExUtils. The new class is placed in the same package (org.apache.commons.lang3) and includes required imports: java.util.Objects, java.util.regex.Matcher, java.util.regex.Pattern. Javadoc and @Deprecated annotations are preserved. No compatibility wrappers are left in RegExUtils because the moved methods were internally self-contained; call sites within RegExUtils were moved as part of the extraction, preserving behavior.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
